aircraft_registration: Luxembourg aircraft registration: LX- and three letters, like `LX-ABC`, or LX-N and five digits for NATO's AWACS aircraft, like `LX-N90442`; the hyphen may be left out.
bic: BIC (SWIFT code) of a Luxembourg bank: four letters, LU and two letters or digits, with an optional three-character branch code, like `BCEELULL` or `BILLLULLXXX`.
company_name: Luxembourg company name with its legal form: S.A., S.à r.l., SARL-S, SAS, SCS, SCSp, SCA, SNC, SE, ASBL, or a fund form (SICAV, SICAF, SICAR, SIF, RAIF, SPF), like `Beta Holding S.A. SPF`; the name may contain de, du, la or d', and never starts with an article such as `La SARL`.
court_case_number: Luxembourg court case number (numéro du rôle) of the district courts (TAL, TAD) and the Court of Appeal (CAL): code, year and five digits, like `TAL-2021-01234`.
iban: Luxembourg IBAN: LU, two check digits and 16 letters or digits, with or without a space every four, like `LU28 0019 4006 4475 0000`.
iccid: SIM card number (ICCID) of a Luxembourg SIM: 89352 followed by 13 to 15 digits, without spaces, like `8935201123456789011`.
id_card_number: Luxembourg identity card number (numéro de la carte d'identité): nine capital letters and digits with at least one of each, like `SPEC07347` or `7D9IB9OLK`.
imsi: IMSI (subscriber identity on a SIM) of a Luxembourg network: mobile country code 270 and 12 more digits, 15 in all, like `270011234567890`.
license_plate: Luxembourg license plate (plaque d'immatriculation): two letters, without I or O, and four digits, like `ZZ 1234` or `ZZ1234`; not the end of a German plate such as B-ZZ 1234.
mobile_number: Luxembourg mobile number (GSM): nine digits in the mobile ranges such as 621, 661 or 691, with or without +352 or 00352, like `628 123 456`; only valid Luxembourg mobile numbers.
mrz_id_card: Machine-readable zone (MRZ) of a Luxembourg identity card, first line (ICAO TD1): 30 characters with LUX as issuing country, like `IDLUXSPEC073476210715<<<<<<<<<`.
mrz_passport: Machine-readable zone (MRZ) of a Luxembourg passport, second line (ICAO TD3): 44 characters with the passport number, LUX as nationality, date of birth, sex and expiry date.
msisdn: Luxembourg mobile number in MSISDN form, as in telecom records: 352 and the nine-digit mobile number, like `352628123456`, not after a +; only valid Luxembourg mobile numbers.
national_number: Luxembourg national identification number (matricule): 13 digits starting with the birth date YYYYMMDD, together or grouped like `1983 0819 012 52`.
passport_number: Luxembourg passport number (numéro de passeport): seven or eight capital letters and digits with at least one of each, like `JC3L7T2H` or `G2A0312`.
phone_number: Luxembourg phone number in international form: +352, 00352 or (+352) and 4 to 10 digits, with spaces, dots, slashes or dashes, like `+352 27 12 34 56`; only valid Luxembourg numbers.
postal_code: Luxembourg postal code (code postal) written with its L- prefix and four digits, like `L-2449`.
rcs_number: Luxembourg trade and companies register number (RCS) after RCS, R.C.S. or Registre de commerce et des sociétés, keyword included, also with Luxembourg (or Lux.) or Diekirch: a section letter and digits, like `R.C.S. Luxembourg B 123.456`.
street_address: Luxembourg street address: house number and a French street type such as rue, avenue or route and the name, like `12, rue de la Gare`, or a Luxembourgish or German name like `Kierchestrooss 7`.
vat_number: Luxembourg VAT number (numéro de TVA): LU and eight digits, together or grouped 3-3-2, like `LU 123 456 13` or `LU12345613`; not the placeholder `LU00000000`.
